title: StatusResponse
description:
`GET /v1/status`: today's admission state, from the `Control` object.

The field order is fixed and is the wire order: the day and the sandbox count and cap
(PR 2), then the guest and demo-account counts and caps (PR 3), then the flag. Readers go
by name, so PR 2's smoke check still passes; a new field is added before `flag`.

day.description: Today's UTC date, `YYYY-MM-DD`: the key of the daily ledger.

demo_account_cap.description: The most demo accounts created in one UTC day.

guest_cap.description: The guests' share of the day's sandboxes.

sandbox_cap.description: The most sandboxes admitted in one UTC day.

Flag.description: The demo's mode, set in `Control` (kill switch L1).

oneOf.description: Only the storefront's static pages work.
